Class Player

java.lang.Object
Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a Player in the game, who has a deck, hand, bench, active Pokemon, and other collections of cards. Provides methods for managing the player's actions, including drawing cards, adding to the bench, and playing different types of cards.
